vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Aurora was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
Aurora showed Dale the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Aurora showed Desmond the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Avery showed Henry the European Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Avery, Aurora, Zoya and Dale met them at the door — 4 put down. Aurora, Zoya, Dale are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Aurora strikes the Elder The Living Wire.
The Elder The Living Wire falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder The Living Wire!
📺 You brought down Elder The Living Wire. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder The Living Wire.
🛡️ Aurora, Zoya, Dale and Desmond met them at the door — 4 put down. Aurora, Zoya, Dale, Desmond are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.

📺 You brought down Elder Drum-Belly. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder Drum-Belly.
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Avery — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Avery chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aurora just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
The Elder Grief Counselor shifts, seeking a clear lane.
The Elder Grief Counselor falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Grief Counselor!
📺 You brought down Elder Grief Counselor. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Tariq just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dale, Henry, Tariq and Devon met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Dale, Henry, Tariq, Devon are hurt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Avery Simon, 24 — a Firefighter. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Scar Tissue, Dowsing, Cold-Blooded, Feast Engine.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Henry just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

killerTaleLog: [day 27] Zoya: The fire settles. Zoya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon mutters "And you're still standing." Aurora says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Avery: The fire settles. Avery has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry says "So it bleeds." Dale says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 29] Avery: The fire settles. Avery has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Glasswing Darter — I put it down today." "A shadow crosses the ground — growing fast. Something is falling out of the sky, straight at you." "It missed. It hits the dirt hard — wings splayed, vulnerable. Kill it now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon asks "Say that again — slower." Dale asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 32] Avery: The fire settles. Avery has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Ducks in a row — I put it down today." "The hissing stops. The line leans forward — it advances, and contact burns." "Every beak in the line, one coordinated bite." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Desmond breathes "We've been walking past those." Tariq mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 33] Henry: The fire settles. Henry has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Katarina mutters "We've been walking past those." Tariq breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 33] Desmond: The fire settles. Desmond has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Lockpick — I put it down today." "It sits up. Its hands move too fast to follow. Something you own is suddenly in its hands." "Cornered, it shows its teeth. It fights second — but it fights." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Katarina asks "The fire feels smaller now." Tariq mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 35] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunback — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still and arches its back to the sun. The mirror-scales catch the light — the glare builds, builds — then it launches, blind-fast, straight at where you were standing." "The thick tail lifts off the ground, swaying once — then sweeps like a felled tree. A monitor's tail is a battering ram with scales." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Desmond mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 36] Avery: The fire settles. Avery has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Static Kite — I put it down today." "The 3x3 scan-mark burns into the ground. The mark is the mercy — MOVE." "It descends to transmit — melee-vulnerable, +50% damage. The only window." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Zoya asks "So it bleeds." Ethan says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 39] Desmond: The fire settles. Desmond has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Avery breathes "Say that again — slower." Dale asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 40] Zoya: The fire settles. Zoya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Union Rep — I put it down today." "'BROTHERS! SISTERS!' Allied monsters hit harder. The speech is the weapon." "'WHO'S WITH ME?' Help is coming." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Henry asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Avery says quietly "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 40] Ethan: The fire settles. Ethan has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon says "And you're still standing." Zoya says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 41] Dale: The fire settles. Dale has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ethan mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Desmond says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 41] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ethan breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Avery breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 41] Avery: The fire settles. Avery has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Static — I put it down today." "It finds your voice in the static. It WEARS it. 'Help— help me—' in YOUR voice. Moving won't help once it has you." "It drops the voice. No static, no words — it RUSHES, no telegraph at all. Back off." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon says quietly "And you're still standing." Desmond says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 43] Katarina: The fire settles. Katarina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tariq says "And you're still standing." Dale says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 50] Avery: The fire settles. Avery has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Performance Review — I put it down today." "A red line draws itself across the ground. 3.2 stars. 'ASSESSMENT IN PROGRESS.' Do not be on the line." "It stamps the air. REJECTED. The word has weight." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon mutters "So it bleeds." Zoya says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 51] Zoya: The fire settles. Zoya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "White Noise — I put it down today." "The heron is gone. No — it's there. It was always there. You just couldn't see it until it moved." "You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Katarina mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Devon says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 58] Zoya: The fire settles. Zoya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Bulldozer — I put it down today." "Lowers its head, paws the earth. Dust rises. It is not going around the tree. It has never gone around anything." "It stops. Blood on its snout, sides heaving. It has decided you are not worth dying for — it backs away, quills flat." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ethan breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Desmond says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 60] Dale: The fire settles. Dale has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Devon says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Katarina breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 78] Thomas: The fire settles. Thomas has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Redactor — I put it down today." "Its white edge-handles grab toward you — pointing. Whatever it points at goes quiet. The handles ARE the telegraph." "The black bars peel off the page — the redacted things come back, wrong and angry." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Tariq breathes "So it bleeds." Dale says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
